title: Random tiredness during the day to the point I have to take a nap or I’ll pass out.
content: The past 2 weeks I’ve been getting so tired around the same time 12:00 pm to 2:00 pm , nothing I do makes me not be tired. I have to go to sleep for a hour or more or I will just start falling asleep at whatever I am doing. I know I am dreaming when I’m sleeping but I can’t remember the dreams . Sounds crazy but almost feels like something is pulling me back to the dream world during the middle of the day…
